title: General parity circuit bounds
statement: For every pair of natural numbers $n$ and $d$ with $2\\le d$, the parity function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, given by the product of all $n$ coordinates, has a depth circuit of depth exactly $d$, size at most $(d-1)b^{d-2}2^b$, and width at most $n$, where $b=\\max\\{1,\\lceil n^{1/(d-1)}\\rceil\\}$.
